title: Report Formatter
summary: A private templated document management platform designed for a client's internal company use, with reusable PDF/Word templates, OCR-assisted reporting, and revision-safe drafts; prepared for production access through Cloudflare Tunnel and Access with administrator-managed membership.
coverAlt: Template builder showing draggable fields and percentage-calculation settings.
coverCaption: Template builder with calculated fields on a synthetic two-page PDF used in browser tests.
contributions: Designed the shared PDF/Word template builder, report editor, and configurable image-extraction workflow.
Specified revision-safe drafts, reusable field defaults, keyboard entry, annotations, calculations, and cross-format export requirements.
Reviewed AI-assisted implementation across the interface, PDF processing, persistence, and regression tests.
